title: fix: restrict file upload size, type, and count
head: xiaofengzii:fix/file-upload-restrictions-5759
body:
## Summary
This PR adds file upload size, type, and count restrictions.

## Changes
- Limit file size to 10MB max
- Restrict accepted MIME types to images (jpeg, png, gif, webp) and documents (pdf, doc, docx, txt)
- Return 400 for invalid uploads with descriptive error messages
- Add tests for valid upload, oversized files, invalid file types, and no file

## Testing
- All tests pass: `node --test src/tests/upload.test.js`

/claim #743
Closes #5759
